acceptance_signals: AGENTS.md defines one owner and one update trigger for each documentation state layer and makes clear that planning, status, and logs do not grant authority.
DEVELOPMENT_PLAN.md describes strategy only and points current execution and historical evidence to their existing canonical surfaces.
STATUS.md documents a concise current-state closeout structure that distinguishes Codex-run, user-reported, pending-validation, and incomplete states.
The change explicitly preserves existing development-log paths and defers historical migration and archive automation.
Documentation tests protect the new responsibility and validation-state contract.
Relevant targeted tests and the baseline unittest suite pass.

decision.rationale: The accountable human reviewed structured proposal prp-9086b4fb8a1e4ba4be23739c21db006a and admitted that exact task through an explicit admission control.

requirement.summary: Define unique responsibilities, update triggers, and precedence boundaries for repository operating rules, strategic planning, current status, durable task and architecture records, and append-only development evidence; keep STATUS.md as the single current-status surface and add a concise closeout template without migrating historical content.

items: Documentation drift could remain if public mirrors and documentation tests are not updated together.
Over-broad cleanup could accidentally become historical migration, which is excluded.
Reviewed assumption: The accepted scope is the first recommended slice only.
Reviewed assumption: STATUS.md remains the current-status filename to avoid adding a duplicate current-state source.
Reviewed assumption: Existing development logs and task evidence references remain at their current paths.

title: Define documentation state separation contract
